newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen firm ahead of Fed decision.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen firm ahead of Fed decision.

text.p: Argentine stocks were seen firm at the opening Tuesday after Monday's national holiday and ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision on interest rates, dealers said.

"The trend abroad is very volatile but there are widespread expectations that the Fed won't touch rates," one dealer said. "So the bolsa should rise at the opening, making up for yesterday's gains in New York and the good mood prevailing abroad today."
The blue-chip MerVal index shed 0.2 percent to 838.71 Friday, closing 1.4 percent lower for the week.
Although the Dow rebounded sharply Monday, leading Argentine ADRs eased. "This was because Friday, when the U.S. market dived, the bolsa held up well," the dealer said.
Traders expected little movement ahead of the Fed decision on rates, expected for 3:15 p.m. (1815 GMT).
"Business will probably pick up after the announcement," said Miguel Daneri at traders Boston Securities.
He said local private pension funds would keep liquidity good on the bolsa and boost support levels. "People will still be cautious, but prices are near a floor," Daneri said.
